questions.name: type
questions.prompt: What kind of information is this?

options.fact: A durable fact about the person themselves (home, job, education, background, possessions, habits)
options.preference: A lasting like, dislike or way the person wants things done
options.relationship: Who another person is to the person (family member, partner, friend, colleague)
options.temporary: A short-lived state such as travel, mood or this week's plans
options.intent: A plan, wish or option being considered, not yet true
options.noise: Small talk or information with no lasting value

questions.name: durable
questions.prompt: Is this a lasting fact, preference or relationship rather than a short-lived state or passing plan?

questions.name: explicit
questions.prompt: Did the person state this directly rather than it being inferred?

questions.name: about_subject
questions.prompt: Is this about the stated subject's own life, preferences or wishes (including who people are to them), rather than a fact about another person's life, job, habits or traits?

questions.name: sensitivity
questions.prompt: How sensitive is this personal information?
levels: Highly sensitive (health, finances, religion, precise location)

questions.name: retraction
questions.prompt: Does the message walk back, soften or deny something the person said earlier, rather than report a new change in their life?

questions.name: conflict
questions.prompt: Which existing memory is about the same thing (same home, job, habit, preference or possession) and is changed, replaced or contradicted by the new message? Pick none if the new message only adds to what is known.

options.none: No existing memory is updated or contradicted

probabilities.label: Highly sensitive (health, finances, religion, precise location)
